name: Moyer Electronic Supply Co
old_description: Local delivery is available, ask your sales representative for details.
about:
Moyer Electronic Supply Co operates from two locations in Sunbury and Pottsville, Pennsylvania. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founder names.

The business functions as an electronic components distributor, maintaining a large inventory of semiconductors, resistors, capacitors, relays, lamps, fuses, and vintage radio and TV parts. It offers same-day shipping on stocked items with no minimum order requirement, along with local delivery, design and installation services, and online purchasing. The company also provides NTE and ECG cross-reference lookup tools.

Target industries and customer types are not explicitly stated in public materials, though the product range suggests service to repair shops, hobbyists, and technicians working with vintage and modern electronics.

Moyer Electronic Supply Co emphasizes its no-minimum-order policy, same-day shipping capability, and local delivery as key differentiators, alongside design and installation support for customers.
